title: Where does your fat actually GO? 🤯
caption: Most doctors in one survey got this wrong. Your fat doesn't turn into energy: about 84% of it leaves through your lungs as CO2. Did you know this, yes or no? 👇
first_comment: Be honest: before this, did you think fat turned into sweat or energy? 💨
sources: Meerman R, Brown AJ. When somebody loses weight, where does the fat go? BMJ 2014;349:g7257 (pubmed 25516540)
NPR, 16 Dec 2014: When You Burn Off That Fat, Where Does It Go? (84% CO2 / 16% water; 10 kg fat needs 29 kg O2)
Survey of 150 professionals in the BMJ paper: about 65% of doctors answered energy/heat
